text:
Liz (AE): Quick heads-up - customer 'Acme Payments' wants BYO-KMS for the POC. They require HSM-backed KEK, 90-day rotation, and an option for on-prem key escrow. Need SOW footprint + delta pricing. Can SE/Sec weigh in? @Sam @Raj

Sam (SE): Got it. Do they need cloud-HSM (cloud provider) or a strict HSM-within-custody (key material never leaves HSM)? Also, expected throughput? small POC or sustained high qps?

Liz (AE): POC is low qps (~50 rps across gen/emb). Main ask: prove they can hold KEKs in their HSM and that Redwood can accept/import wrapped CMKs. Procurement also asked about rotation procedures and billing if we fetch/unwrap for caching.

Raj (Security): We need to confirm we can support both: 1) CMK import (wrapped) and 2) external-sign-only flow. Questions: supported key wrapping algos, RSA-2048 vs RSA-3072, ECDSA support, HSM attestation artifacts, and audit log export format. Also need retention requirements.

Sam (SE): We support two flows:
1) BYOK import where customer uploads a wrapped model key (KEK-wrapped). Example CLI:
``
redwoodctl kms import --wrapped-key-file kek.bin --wrap-algo RSA-OAEP-256 --customer-kid "cust-123"
```
Latency note: if we proxy signing to customer's HSM, expect ~+5-10ms per crypto op depending on region.
2) External-sign-only: HSM signs proofs, we store references. No plaintext key material in our runtime.

Liz (AE): Pricing question from procurement: they asked for per-signing-unit pricing vs flat monthly key fee. Any guidance?

Sam (SE): Recommend hybrid: small flat monthly key fee + per-100k-sign ops. For POC we can waive op fees under 100k ops to avoid blocker. I'll draft two sample numbers (monthly + ops).

Eva (Customer): (joined) Confirming: we need a rotation window of 7 days for cutover and rollback plan. Can Redwood do a canary cutover pinned by percentage?

Sam (SE): Yes - we support canary via route-level policy. You can pin X% traffic to new CMK for a configurable period and auto-rollback on error rate > threshold.

Raj (Security): Clarify key escrow: who holds escrow copies? Customer prefers they hold escrow. If Redwood holds escrow, legal must sign escrow/KMS custody agreement and accept SLA. Also list of attestations required: FIPS 140-2 L3, HSM cert, vendor model, firmware version, audit log export (JSON/CSV), and tamper-evidence logs.

Liz (AE): Action items: Sam - send SOW diff (BYOK + HSM notes) + sample pricing. Raj - compile security Qs & required attestations. I'll coordinate PO and timeline with Acme.

deploy-bot: POC environment for acct-acme provisioned (env-id: poc-acme-2026). Access information emailed to acme-sec@acme.com :tada:

Sam (SE): Draft SOW uploaded to drive, will ping here in ~2h with numbers and example contract language.

Raj (Security): Attestations checklist (short): FIPS 140-2 L3 proof, HSM vendor cert, key wrapping algos list, rotation audit logs retention (>= 12 months), attestation timestamp + signer. Doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/kms/hsm-attestations

Liz (AE): Perfect - thanks all. If legal needs a template for escrow, ping me and I'll loop them in. Closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
